newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Pakistani, Indian for drugs, murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Pakistani, Indian for drugs, murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday beheaded a Pakistani man for heroin smuggling and an Indian for murder, raising the number of people executed so far this year to 80.

An Interior Ministry statement carried by the official Saudi Press Agency said the Pakistani was executed in the capital Riyadh after a court found him guilty of smuggling an unspecified quantity of heroin into the conservative kingdom.
A separate statement from the ministry, read on Saudi state television, said the Indian man was beheaded in Riyadh for killing a Pakistani.
Saudi Arabia applies Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading by the sword convicted murderers, rapists, drug traffickers and other criminals. A total of 68 people were beheaded in 1996.
